cost.arm_semantics: Old auxiliary samples are balanced using class metadata. Anchor KD targets frozen-teacher soft distributions rather than old gold answers, but class labels still determine balanced sampling; it is not wholly label-free. Anchor Gold uses labeled old gold answers. Comparisons bundle target and compute differences.
cost.compute_interpretation: WorkMeter forward calls/input tokens are proxies, not FLOPs or GPU busy time; soft-KD and Gold auxiliary paths have different computation.
cost.external_costs_not_in_seal: Keep the separate 48-update interference diagnostic, 18-update qualification, and any earlier failed-probe costs in the external report ledger.
